purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Wajir East Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, capturing the page's final polling-station rows and the highlighted TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (code 034) was read from the visible 'CON 034' banner marker and the '008034' county-constituency polling-station code prefix printed on the page before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-034-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile exactly on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 22,020 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, unlike the recurring special-facility pattern documented elsewhere in this Atlas, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (35,003) is LOWER than the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator (35,794) by 791, rather than higher via an uncounted special-facility station. The one non-ward polling station visible on this page ('049292145102001 WAJIR - 01', registered 9) is already included within the printed 35,003 total, so it cannot explain a shortfall. No special-facility or non-ward polling-station code was found anywhere on this form's pages that would explain the gap, and both figures were independently re-confirmed (the printed total re-read on the rendered page image; the governed figure re-queried from data/indicators/registry/observations.json). No cause is asserted here since none is evidenced on the source; this mirrors the same below-governed-denominator pattern already documented for Kasipul in data/p23/form34b-kasipul-source-verification.json. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
